messages:
auditor_raja: Morning team — ISO/SOC auditor. We need an evidence bundle for an emergency ephemeral access grant on 2024-10-29 that was used during CVE-2024-9999 triage. Please include: 1) IAM change records showing grant + revoke, 2) KMS operations (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) across regions (us-east-1 and eu-west-1), 3) the vuln ticket (CVE-2024-9999/TKT-8122), and 4) a short control mapping (ISO A.9 / SOC2 CC6). Can you produce a single package with manifest + checksums and note redaction rules?

samira_devsec: Noted. This was an ephemeral role grant to user svc-ephemeral for 16 minutes. Ticket TKT-8122 contains the triage notes. I will pull CloudTrail events and the GitOps PR that created the temporary grant.

leo_infra: KMS key used: alias/redwood-ephemeral-eu (keyId=eu-9a8b7c6d). Also alias/redwood-ephemeral-us (keyId=us-1a2b3c4d). I see GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext at 2024-10-29T02:14:06Z (us-east-1) and Decrypt at 02:18:09Z (eu-west-1) — cross-region forensic decrypts. I'll export cloudtrail JSON for both KeyIds and include eventIDs.

zayn_oncall: Splunk quick query I used (will export raw + redact IPs):
```
index=cloudtrail (eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com OR eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com) userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:iam::*:user/svc-ephemeral" earliest="2024-10-29T02:00:00" latest="2024-10-29T03:00:00"
| table _time, eventName, eventID, requestParameters, awsRegion, responseElements
```
I'll put JSON export + screenshots into s3://redwood-compliance/tmp/CVE-2024-9999/ by EOD.

evidence-bot: Notice: detected emergency grant -> gitops/pr/5931 merged at 2024-10-29T02:12:30Z (applied role: svc-ephemeral -> security-triage). Revert PR merged at 2024-10-29T02:28:45Z.

auditor_raja: Originals required for verification but redacted copies are fine for initial upload. Please include: manifest.csv (filename, sha256, eventID, region), mapping.md (control -> artifact), redaction rules, and the HMAC of the manifest using the compliance key. Auditors will request originals under NDA for final validation.

samira_devsec: Will produce: manifest.csv, mapping.md, redaction_script.sh, redacted/ and originals/ folders. Plan to HMAC manifest with KMS-stored compliance key alias/redwood-compliance-hmac (keyId=cmp-5555aaaa). We'll include the HMAC value in the package.

leo_infra: Packaging plan: create redacted tar.gz and a sealed originals tar.gz (gated). Paths: redacted -> s3://redwood-compliance/redacted/CVE-2024-9999/, originals -> s3://redwood-compliance/originals/CVE-2024-9999/. I'll add CloudTrail eventIDs in manifest so you can cross-check.

zayn_oncall: One Q: can we redact internal hostnames and IPs? we typically remove internal DNS names and 10.x/172.16.x addresses.

auditor_raja: Redacted is fine for the initial review. Please list exact redaction regexes in redaction_script.sh and include SHA256 of originals in the manifest. We'll request a secure remote session to verify originals if needed.

samira_devsec: Action items: leo -> KMS exports + eventIDs; zayn -> Splunk exports + PR diff + approver list; I'll draft mapping.md linking artifacts to ISO A.9.2.3 and SOC2 CC6.1/CC7.

leo_infra: Uploaded redacted exports to s3://redwood-compliance/redacted/CVE-2024-9999/redacted-evidence.tar.gz
sha256: 7b6f8e2d1c3a4b5f9d0e1c2a3b4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d
HMAC(manifest): hmac-sha256: f1e2d3c4b5a697887766554433221100ffeeddccbbaa99887766554433221100

zayn_oncall: I added PR link + approver list to the package: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/pr/5931 and approvers.csv (contains two emergency approvers and the oncall ack).

samira_devsec: mapping.md excerpt: "ISO A.9.2.3 (user access provisioning) -> CloudTrail IAM events + GitOps PR; SOC2 CC6.1 (change management) -> PR diff + approver list; SOC2 CC7 (system operations) -> KMS operation logs."

auditor_raja: Received. I'll schedule a verification window for originals next Tuesday under NDA. Please keep originals ACL locked and share reviewer steps. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
